categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production process quality detection and control solutions sector. Its main business segments include online automated measurement and control systems and machine vision intelligent inspection systems. These products serve industries such as new energy batteries, films, non-woven fabrics and sanitary materials, papermaking, and are expanding into the semiconductor field.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies encompass X/β-ray sensor technology, microwave moisture detection, spectral measurement, scanning frame detection, embedded high-speed data processing, closed-loop control, high-speed industrial line scan camera technology, FPGA-based image processing, and AI-driven defect detection algorithms. Production follows an order-driven model with standardized component stocking, involving custom mechanical parts design and assembly, with engineering teams responsible for product debugging and customer training.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in the new energy battery sector (e.g., Honeycomb Energy, Sunwoda, EVE Energy), film industry (e.g., Foster, Jinwei Machinery), non-woven fabric and sanitary materials (e.g., Nobang, Yanjiang), and papermaking (e.g., Xianhe, Zaisheng). The company’s products are widely used in these industries for quality control and process optimization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are predominantly domestic within China, with growing international presence in countries including the United States, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Turkey. The headquarters and main production base are located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology operates primarily as a midstream supplier, providing core detection and control equipment and systems to manufacturing enterprises. It is evolving from a system supplier to also developing and supplying core sensor components, enhancing its position in the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on enhancing sensor precision, AI algorithm development, and expanding into semiconductor wafer inspection technologies. It is developing AI training platforms and intelligent cameras for edge computing, aiming to integrate AI capabilities into industrial applications. Strategic priorities include expanding market reach domestically and internationally, and building a smart detection core component supply platform.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized automated measurement and control systems, machine vision inspection systems, system components, and maintenance services. The company employs a staged payment model tied to order signing, delivery, acceptance, and warranty periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in machine vision include international firms like IsraVision and Wintriss, with Zhejiang Shuangyuan’s products achieving comparable performance levels. In process control, it competes with global leaders such as Honeywell and ABB but has established a strong domestic presence with advanced technology and expanding applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 386.2 million, a 10% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 86.9 million, down 34.9%. R&D expenses increased by over 30%, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 2.67 billion and net assets of RMB 2.13 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology differentiates itself through integrated solutions combining online automated measurement and machine vision inspection, offering high precision, real-time closed-loop control, and AI-enhanced defect detection. Its proprietary sensor technologies and embedded processing capabilities provide competitive advantages in speed, accuracy, and adaptability across multiple industrial applications. The company’s strong R&D and project management capabilities enable tailored solutions that improve production quality and efficiency for leading customers.
